full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079
Sixth Session
Meeting Number - 60
Notice - 2
(Brief Minutes of the Meeting Proceedings)
Wednesday, Bhadra 18, 2082
The meeting of the House of Representatives commenced today at 1:15 PM under the chairmanship of the Right Honourable Speaker Devraj Ghimire.
At the beginning of the meeting, when the Honourable Members from Rastriya Swatantra Party and Rastriya Prajatantra Party stood in front of their seats, the Right Honourable Speaker gave time to Hon. Hari Dhakal and Hon. Jan Bahadur Shahi, who respectively spoke about the need for investigation into the Visit Visa case through a parliamentary inquiry committee or a high-level judicial commission, stating that the ruling party has been making false accusations without listening to the protests in the House for 95 days, that democracy cannot be strengthened by suppressing voices of protest, that the import of foreign apples with chemicals should be stopped and local apples from Jumla, which have come to the market, should be commercialized, that some road sections in Jumla are blocked due to landslides and arrangements including equipment should be made to open the roads quickly, and other related issues.
After Hon. Gyan Bahadur Shahi finished speaking, the Honourable Members from Rastriya Swatantra Party and Rastriya Prajatantra Party walked out of the meeting hall.
Thereafter, the following Honourable Members, in the impromptu session, spoke about the need for immediate and easy supply of drinking water in the Terai districts including Rautahat, the immediate provision of facilities due to be provided to drought-affected areas as Madhesh Province has been declared a drought-affected region, the need to amend the integrated ambulance service procedure recently issued by the Ministry of Health, as the operation of ambulance services only by hospitals could affect the emergency services for the public, the need to immediately address the demands of sugarcane farmers who are protesting with various demands through negotiation, the immediate repair of the Kamala bridge under the Postal Highway, the need to immediately open the blocked roads and provide relief and compensation to the victims as landslides have blocked the Mid-Himalayan Lokmarg and the Saljhandi-Dhorpatan road section in Baglung causing significant physical damage, the establishment of an administrative service center in Galchot, Baglung, the need to facilitate the repatriation of the body of Dambar Bahadur Magar from Dhankuta, who is working abroad, due to his death from consuming poisonous liquor, the need for immediate filling of vacant positions for health workers at the Khotang District Hospital as it is affecting health services, and the need for the government to provide adequate budget for the development of the Karnali region, among other issues:-

Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker read out the following letter received from the Office of the President:-
"The Right Honourable President, Mr. Ram Chandra Paudel, is scheduled to depart for China on Saturday, Bhadra 14, 2082, to participate in the 25th Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) to be held in Tianjin, China, and the event titled '80th Commemoration of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War' to be held in Beijing, China. Therefore, during his absence, the daily administrative work to be carried out by the Prime Minister will be handled by the Right Honourable Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Urban Development, Mr. Prakash Man Singh, as recommended by the Right Honourable Prime Minister in accordance with the Constitution of Nepal. I humbly request this.
(Dr. Deepak Kafle)
Date: 2082/04/13
Secretary
Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker read out the following letters received from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers:-
a) It is requested that the Honourable Minister for Education, Science and Technology, Mr. Raghuji Pant, will be participating in the 25th Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) to be held in Tianjin, China, and the event titled '80th Commemoration of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War' to be held in Beijing, China, as part of the delegation led by the Right Honourable Prime Minister, Mr. K.P. Sharma Oli, and departing for there on Saturday, Bhadra 14, 2082. Therefore, during his absence, the responsibilities of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, which he has been handling, will be managed by the Honourable Minister for Communications and Information Technology, Mr. Prithvi Subba Gurung, as designated by the Right Honourable Prime Minister.
Date: 2082/05/13
(Ek Narayan Aryal)
Chief Secretary
b) It is requested that the Honourable Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, Mr. Badrī Prasad Pande, will be participating in the 25th Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) to be held in Tianjin, China, and the event titled '80th Commemoration of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War' to be held in Beijing, China, as part of the delegation led by the Right Honourable Prime Minister, Mr. K.P. Sharma Oli, and departing for there on Saturday, Bhadra 14, 2082. Therefore, during his absence, the responsibilities of the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, which he has been handling, will be managed by the Honourable Minister for Youth and Sports, Mr. Tej Lal Chaudhary, as designated by the Right Honourable Prime Minister.
Page 2/4
(Ek Narayan Aryal)
Date: 2082/05/13
Chief Secretary
Thereafter, the Secretary of the House of Representatives, Harkaraj Rai, tabled the bill along with the message received from the National Assembly regarding the "Water Resources Bill, 2081".
After that, the Right Honourable Speaker informed about a minor change in the agenda for today.
Subsequently, the Honourable Minister for Home Affairs, Ramesh Lekhak, presented a proposal for consideration of the "Bill to Amend the Nepal Citizenship Act (Second Amendment), 2081, with amendments made by the National Assembly".
Thereafter, the Honourable Home Minister Ramesh Lekhak responded to the questions raised by the following Honourable Members during the discussion on the bill:-

Thereafter, the Right Honourable Speaker presented the proposal "Consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Bill to Amend the Nepal Citizenship Act (Second Amendment), 2081" for decision, and it was approved by a majority.
Subsequently, the Right Honourable Speaker informed about the decision to hold the election for the vacant Chairperson position in the Parliamentary Hearing Committee on Friday, Bhadra 20, 2082, in consultation with the Honourable Chairperson of the National Assembly, as per Rule 25 of the Rules of Procedure for the Joint Session and Joint Committee of the Federal Parliament, 2080, and directed the Secretary-General of the Federal Parliament, Mr. Padra Prasad Pandey, to publish the notice regarding the election of the committee chairperson.
Thereafter, the Honourable Minister for Agriculture and Livestock Development, Mr. Ramnath Adhikari, presented a proposal for consideration of the "Bill to Amend the Nepal Veterinary Council Act (First Amendment), 2082".
After that, the Honourable Minister for Agriculture and Livestock Development, Ramnath Adhikari, responded to the questions raised by the following Honourable Members during the discussion on the bill:-

Thereafter, when the Right Honourable Speaker presented the proposal "Consider the Bill to Amend the Nepal Veterinary Council Act (First Amendment), 2082" for decision, Hon. Hitraj Pandey raised a point regarding the lack of quorum in the House. Following this, the Right Honourable Speaker directed the Secretariat to ascertain the quorum, stating that according to Article 94 of the Constitution of Nepal, one-fourth of the members of the House of Representatives must be present to present any question or proposal for decision. After the ringing of the quorum bell for 3 minutes and counting the number of present Honourable Members, it was found that the required quorum was 69, but only 49 Honourable Members were present. Therefore, it was informed that the remaining agenda items have been removed from the proceedings.
Subsequently, the next meeting of the House of Representatives was adjourned until Thursday, Bhadra 19, 2082, at 1:00 PM, and the current meeting was adjourned at 6:34 PM.
Padra Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The meeting began with Honourable Members from Rastriya Swatantra Party and Rastriya Prajatantra Party standing, followed by speeches from Hon. Hari Dhakal and Hon. Jan Bahadur Shahi on issues like the Visit Visa case investigation and local apple commercialization. The members then walked out.

speakers.topic: Visit Visa case, local apple commercialization, road blockages

speakers.name: Jan Bahadur Shahi
speakers.topic: Visit Visa case, local apple commercialization, road blockages

sections.name: Impromptu Session
sections.summary_en: Several Honourable Members raised concerns during the impromptu session, including issues related to drinking water scarcity, drought relief, ambulance services, sugarcane farmer protests, bridge repair, road blockages and compensation, administrative service centers, repatriation of deceased citizens, hospital staffing, and regional development.

speakers.name: Rama Koirala Poudyal
speakers.topic: Drinking water, drought relief, ambulance services

speakers.name: Janardan Sharma
speakers.topic: Road blockages, victim relief, administrative services

sections.name: Zero Hour
sections.summary_en: During the Zero Hour, numerous Honourable Members presented their views on various contemporary issues.

sections.name: Special Time
sections.summary_en: In the Special Time, several Honourable Members expressed their views on contemporary issues.

sections.name: Presidential Office Communication
sections.summary_en: The Speaker read out a letter from the Office of the President regarding the President's upcoming trip to China for the SCO Summit and a victory commemoration event, designating the Deputy Prime Minister to handle administrative tasks during the President's absence.

sections.name: Prime Minister's Office Communication
sections.summary_en: The Speaker read out two letters from the Prime Minister's Office concerning the temporary assignment of ministerial duties during the absence of the Minister for Education, Science and Technology and the Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, who will be accompanying the Prime Minister to China.

sections.name: Tabling of Bills and Motions
sections.summary_en: The Secretary tabled the Water Resources Bill, 2081, received from the National Assembly. The agenda was slightly adjusted. The Minister for Home Affairs then presented a motion to consider amendments made by the National Assembly to the Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2081.

speakers.name: Ramesh Lekhak
speakers.topic: Motion to consider Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2081

sections.name: Discussion on Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill
sections.summary_en: Following the presentation of the motion, Honourable Members raised questions, to which the Home Minister responded. The proposal to consider the amendments made by the National Assembly to the Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2081, was subsequently approved by a majority vote.

speakers.name: Ramesh Lekhak
speakers.topic: Response to questions on Citizenship Bill

sections.name: Election of Parliamentary Hearing Committee Chairperson
sections.summary_en: The Speaker announced that the election for the vacant Chairperson position of the Parliamentary Hearing Committee would be held on Bhadra 20, 2082, and instructed the Secretary-General to publish the notice.

sections.name: Discussion on Nepal Veterinary Council (First Amendment) Bill
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Agriculture and Livestock Development presented the Nepal Veterinary Council (First Amendment) Bill, 2082, for consideration. Following discussions where Honourable Members raised questions, the Minister provided responses. However, the meeting was adjourned due to a lack of quorum.

speakers.name: Ramnath Adhikari
speakers.topic: Response to questions on Veterinary Council Bill

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The meeting was adjourned due to a lack of quorum after it was determined that only 49 members were present, falling short of the required 69. The next meeting is scheduled for Bhadra 19, 2082.
